about: SCION 13 · Secondary Motion. Per scene frame, measured from a mask pass of the drawn dog (the same geometry drawn into the film, rasterised at 320x180 in three groups: torso, head, limbs). x_screen/y_screen: dog pixel centroid; x_world_measured: that centroid unprojected through the (moving) camera onto the dog path plane Z=0, metres along the porch; facing: +1 when the head centroid is left of the torso centroid (toward the door), -1 when right (its back to the door); posture from the torso centroid height; head_below_back: head centroid below the top of the torso mask. state and x_score are copied from the score.
facing_convention: +1 toward the door (left on screen), -1 away
